ownCases: Special extra title keys/blank names retain identity and values across restore/reopen; custom orphan title blocks core erasure
Legacy literal default stays literal; explicit undefined title table rejects
Queued Run preparation makes earlier exported empty journal fail execution-time guard
Format getter never runs; full local counters and unknown extension reject
Unknown disk marker/bad legacy names preserve bytes; failed init releases owned lock

maintainability.assessment: Store-local named validators separate full envelope/core projection and legacy init/restore; reuse existing core/organization/Run validators, queue, CAS and atomic writer; no second authority, bus, module inventory or provider.

limitations: No formal candidate, production migration/downgrade/restore or authorization expansion; 018 gate and old-reader compatibility debt unchanged
Full journal must match target owner at writer execution, not a cross-owner Run attestation migration format
Synthetic temporary Stores and actual loopback HTTP; no production profile/user data/private Session/credentials/model calls
No real Desktop, ReactDOM/native/focus/IME or human experience acceptance
No whole-suite or power-loss/kill durability testing; no software install/lifecycle/system/Git mutation
